items.text: Among patients aged 75 and over discharged alive from the medical wards with a social work referral between January 2023 and December 2025, is an attended family meeting with a written plan associated with unplanned readmission within 30 days, after adjustment for case complexity?
items.population: Patients aged 75 and over discharged alive from the medical wards with a social work referral, 2023 to 2025
items.intervention: Family discharge planning meeting attended by a family member and ending with a written plan (exposure, read from notes)
items.comparator: No family meeting, or a booked meeting that the family did not attend
items.outcome: Unplanned readmission to this hospital within 30 days of discharge

finer: Feasible with 120 hours of note reading if cases and sampled controls are read; interesting to the medical director and social work; novel for routine meetings in this hospital; ethical as secondary use of notes with a waiver request; relevant to a hospital-wide policy decision.
summary: One PECO question with the exposure defined as an attended meeting with a written plan.
